title: Topological charges and parity selection at Floquet quasienergy degeneracies
summary: The quasienergy spectrum of a strongly driven two-level system as a function of the driving parameters exhibits conical intersections, which are enabled by hidden time-nonlocal symmetries. We show that each such crossing carries a quantized topological charge: the Floquet--Berry phase acquired along an adiabatic loop around a cone is equal to a $\mathbb{Z}_2$-valued charge. We further identify a second family of degeneracies that occurs at vanishing driving amplitude, when the level splitting matches $m$ energy quanta of the field.
